# Anshu Kushwaha — Full-Stack Engineer & Cloud Architect

## Summary
Anshu Kushwaha is a full-stack software engineer and cloud architect with 9+ years of continuous experience at Quancore Softech (Sep 2015 – Present). He builds production-grade web platforms, Kubernetes infrastructure, and distributed systems.

## Core Skills
- Languages: Python (FastAPI, Celery), Node.js (TypeScript, Express), PHP (Laravel, Bagisto), Go (Golang)
- Frontend: React, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Angular
- Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Docker, Terraform, ArgoCD, CI/CD Pipelines
- Cloud: AWS (EKS, S3, RDS, IAM), GCP (GKE, Cloud Run, Artifact Registry), Hostinger
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, Apache Kafka, Elasticsearch
- Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Istio Service Mesh
- Specialties: WebRTC, GPU Workload Scheduling, Multi-Tenant Architecture, Event-Driven Systems

## Key Projects
1. Dzicard (dzicard.com) — Digital card and poster generation engine processing 500,000+ cards with <850ms render latency
2. Expoburg (expoburg.com) — B2B virtual trade exhibition platform supporting 12,000+ concurrent users with real-time WebRTC conferencing
3. NuHire (developer.nuhire.in) — Kubernetes platform with GPU-aware scheduling, DMZ isolation, and 74% image pull time reduction
4. Infizero (infizero.com) — Multi-tenant ERP system with equipment rental management, dynamic forms, and QR asset tracking
5. MyVapi (myvapi.com) — Hyperlocal city portal and B2B business directory with 100+ categories and 94.2% cache ratio
6. Enterprise Storefronts & Telegram Bots — Bagisto/Magento commerce platforms with automated Telegram bot systems (91% auto-resolution)

## Career Timeline
